title: Insomniacs After School
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In the small city of Nanao, high schooler Ganta Nakami, whose insomnia stems from his mother leaving the family, finds cheerful classmate Isaki Magari already napping in the school's abandoned observatory. Both are insomniacs, and they revive the defunct astronomy club, take up astrophotography and slowly grow close while Isaki lives with a serious congenital heart condition.
life_message: It holds up shared quiet passions, honesty about one's struggles, and staying beside those we care for.
